description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to a worker thread pool system, including the IWorkerPool interface, the WorkerPool implementation, and nested classes for managing timers, scheduling, and monitoring dispatched jobs within a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: IWorkerPool
classes.description: Interface for a worker thread pool, providing methods for submitting, scheduling, rescheduling, revoking jobs, and obtaining snapshots.

classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: Implementation of a thread pool managing worker threads, timers, scheduling, and monitoring, supporting job submission, rescheduling, revoking, and thread identification.

classes.name: WorkerPool::Timer
classes.description: Represents a timer associated with the worker pool, used for scheduling and timed execution of jobs.

classes.name: WorkerPool::Scheduler
classes.description: Handles scheduling of jobs within the worker pool, interfacing with the timer.

classes.name: WorkerPool::DispatchedJobMonitor
classes.description: Monitors dispatched jobs for analysis and reporting, including warning about long-running jobs.

classes.name: WorkerPool::DispatchedJobMonitor::MontiorJob
classes.description: A job that periodically analyzes and reports dispatched jobs.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IWorkerPool.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the worker pool is available.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the worker pool.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job to run at a specific time.

methods.name: Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules a job to a new time.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a scheduled or running job.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Waits for all jobs to complete.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID for a given index.

methods.name: Snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current worker pool state.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker pool's processing loop.
